description: This file defines the TalkModeManager class, responsible for managing voice interactions in an Android app. It handles speech recognition, text-to-speech playback, session subscriptions, and integration with external gateway sessions for chat. The class includes functionality for speech recognition lifecycle, TTS playback, event handling, and configuration management.

classes.name: TalkModeManager
classes.description: Manages speech recognition, text-to-speech, and chat session interactions for voice capabilities in the app. Provides methods to start/stop listening, handle recognition events, manage TTS playback, subscribe to chat sessions, and handle external gateway events.

methods.name: ensureChatSubscribed
methods.description: Ensures chat subscription is active if supported, re-subscribes if needed.

methods.name: setMainSessionKey
methods.description: Sets the main session key used for context in chat and session subscriptions.

methods.name: setEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables the voice interaction mode, starting or stopping recognition accordingly.

methods.name: speakWakeCommand
methods.description: Executes a wake command, sending chat, waiting for reply, and playing assistant response.

methods.name: playTtsForText
methods.description: Plays a given text via TTS, managing playback tokens.

methods.name: handleGatewayEvent
methods.description: Processes external gateway events related to chat and agent responses.

methods.name: setPlaybackEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables TTS playback for responses.

methods.name: refreshConfig
methods.description: Reloads the talk mode configuration from the gateway.

methods.name: speakAssistantReply
methods.description: Plays an assistant reply text via TTS, ensuring configuration and playback are active.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initiates speech recognition if available and permitted.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops recognition, TTS playback, and cleans up resources.

methods.name: startListeningInternal
methods.description: Starts recognition with specific intent parameters.

methods.name: scheduleRestart
methods.description: Schedules a restart of recognition after a delay.

methods.name: handleTranscript
methods.description: Handles incoming speech recognition results, processing partial and final transcripts.

methods.name: startSilenceMonitor
methods.description: Begins monitoring for silence to finalize recognition.

methods.name: checkSilence
methods.description: Checks if silence duration warrants finalizing the recognition.

methods.name: finalizeTranscript
methods.description: Finalizes recognition result, sends chat, and initiates response playback.

methods.name: subscribeChatIfNeeded
methods.description: Subscribes to chat session if not already subscribed and supported.

methods.name: buildPrompt
methods.description: Constructs the prompt to send, incorporating context and last interruptions.

methods.name: sendChat
methods.description: Sends a chat message and returns the run ID.

methods.name: waitForChatFinal
methods.description: Waits for chat response finalization with timeout.

methods.name: cacheRunCompletion
methods.description: Caches the completion state of a chat run.

methods.name: consumeRunCompletion
methods.description: Removes and returns the completion state for a run.

methods.name: consumeRunText
methods.description: Removes and returns the text content of a finished run.

methods.name: extractTextFromChatEventMessage
methods.description: Extracts plain text from chat event JSON message.

methods.name: waitForAssistantText
methods.description: Polls for assistant reply text after a certain timestamp.

methods.name: fetchLatestAssistantText
methods.description: Fetches latest assistant message history from server.

methods.name: playAssistant
methods.description: Plays assistant response text via TTS, handling directives and language/voice settings.

methods.name: runPlaybackSession
methods.description: Wraps TTS playback with setup and cleanup logic.

methods.name: cancelActivePlayback
methods.description: Cancels ongoing TTS playback if any.

methods.name: speakWithSystemTts
methods.description: Speaks text using Android's TextToSpeech engine, managing utterance lifecycle.

methods.name: stopTts
methods.description: Stops TTS and resets speaking status.

methods.name: stopSpeaking
methods.description: Halts ongoing speech playback, cleanup, and state update.

methods.name: shouldAllowSpeechInterrupt
methods.description: Determines if speech can be interrupted based on in-flight state.

methods.name: clearListenWatchdog
methods.description: Cancels the silence monitoring job.

methods.name: requestAudioFocusForTts
methods.description: Requests audio focus for TTS playback.

methods.name: abandonAudioFocus
methods.description: Releases audio focus after TTS.

methods.name: ensureTextToSpeech
methods.description: Initializes and retrieves TextToSpeech engine instance.

methods.name: stopTextToSpeechPlayback
methods.description: Stops ongoing TTS speech playback.

methods.name: shutdownTextToSpeech
methods.description: Shuts down TTS engine and clears references.

methods.name: shouldInterrupt
methods.description: Decides whether current speech should be interrupted based on transcript.

methods.name: ensurePlaybackActive
methods.description: Checks if playback is still active based on current token.

methods.name: isPlaybackCancelled
methods.description: Determines if playback was canceled based on thrown error.

methods.name: reloadConfig
methods.description: Fetches and applies talk mode configuration from server.
